title: Loan approval
goal: Show automated consumer-loan decisioning with a genuine manual-review loop.

rubric.must: The identity-verification diamond has a No branch reaching the Decline application terminator.
The No branch from the credit-score decision reaches Decline application without passing through Manual underwriting review.
A request-for-evidence decision visibly routes document collection back into manual underwriting review.
Both automated and underwriter-approved paths visibly converge on Generate loan offer and then Offer issued.
The borderline credit outcome visibly enters manual underwriting rather than the automatic offer path.
The key decision branches have readable outcome labels.
